Uncle Ben's Hell Hole

By: Mart-Marie Faure | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
Uncle Ben’s Den is a care facility for elderly, homeless , mentally and physically disabled people. The facility director is Ronel van Dyk. Although the facility has appeared on Kyknet and received money from Lottoland there have been many complaints about the ill treatment, neglect and verbal abuse.
Residents are crammed into houses without hot water and electricity. There is not much supervision and residents are often not given required medication . They would get into fights often harming each other or themselves.
Residents complain that they are fed bread with no butter and mostly receive pap and spinach or a bit of rice with vegetables leaving many malnourished.
Ronel has been accused of being verbally abusive . (Voice clip available) A meeting was called in the hall and 180 people attended. Ronel proceeded to , verbally abuse some of the residents.
The rooms have no electricity or hot water. 8-13 people live in a house sharing 1 bathroom The bathroom has no door or curtain . There is a small chair where they can sit to wash themselves with cold water.
.
A family member of one of the residents paid the facility a visit after her aunt had passed away as she needed the funeral policy. On being questioned about the policy and her aunt’s bank accounts an altercation ensued and Ronel van Dyk assaulted the family member . She reported it to the police . A previous worker at the facility provided photos of residents with bedsores and says that van Dyk was often verbally abusive.
Audio recordings of verbal abuse and altercation available.
Police and social workers have visited the facility but were not allowed on the premises.
VryheidsFront Plus and the Department of Social Development are actively looking into the allegations and have tried to gain access to the facility. It has always been denied will be visiting the facility. Mrs Mamabula from Social Development confirmed that no facility may refuse access by social workers or the police.
Residents who have managed to leave the facility have complained of a lack of food some weighing less than 50kg.



Summary:
Uncle Ben's Den has been widely criticised on social media and Hello Peter.
In an email, UBD director Ronel van Dyk has invited Carte Blanche to visit the facility at any time unannounced.
According to the Department of Social Development UBD was registered as an NPO in 2007 but has since been deregistered. If a facility is not registered as an NPO and advertises as an NPO it is operating illegally.
It should comply or face closure. Social workers from the department and SAPS have tried to get access to the facility but has been denied entry.
